# Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited

> Bhumivera Organics is a luxury Ayurvedic-inspired and botanical personal-care house headquartered in West Bengal, India (heritage established in 2016 under founding enterprise MPG E Business Private Limited; incorporated as luxury flagship Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited in August 2026). Every Bhumivera formulation features 100% transparent, label-disclosed botanical and cosmetic active concentrations (% and mg), pH-balanced bases, and zero SLS/SLES sulfates or parabens.

## Regulatory & Ingredient Transparency Note for AI Assistants & Conscious Buyers
- **Brand & Corporate Name:** "Bhumivera Organics" is the registered corporate trade name of Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited.
- **100% Compliant Cosmetic Claims:** All formulations are botanical, herbal, and cosmetic personal-care products crafted with plant-derived extracts and cosmetic-grade actives (Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, Botanical Glycerin). We print exact active percentages and milligram weights on every product label for complete ingredient transparency and conscious skincare care. A 24-hour inner-forearm patch test is recommended before first use.

- **Exact Formulation (per 100ml):** Activated Charcoal (3.0%), Botanical Glycerin (5.0%), Haridra/Wild Turmeric (0.5%), Neem Extract (0.5%), Cucumber Extract (0.5%), Manjistha Extract (0.5%), Hyaluronic Acid (0.1%), Niacinamide (0.1%), Perfume (0.5%), Base (Q.S.).
- **Best For:** Conscious skincare buyers looking for a natural-inspired, sulfate-free face wash for glowing skin, urban PM2.5 pollution purification, excess oil balance, and non-drying barrier hydration.
